These notices are copied verbatim from `info/licenses/` in the published
`mojo-snappy-0.2.0-hb0f4dca_0.conda` artifact:

https://prefix.dev/modular-community/linux-64/mojo-snappy-0.2.0-hb0f4dca_0.conda

The packaged recipe identifies source revision
`1bb71bec224d3d262d6a542dd872da7f2a665b9c` in
https://github.com/idlab-discover/mojo-snappy.

The artifact declares `Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause` and requires

or compiled binary is vendored here. Update the notices when changing releases.
